Nadda labeled the opposition's rally at Ramlila Maidan as a calculated conspiracy against democracy and the economy. He outlined a model of politics involving misinformation and provoking protests. The INDIA bloc, however, claims to mobilize for democratic rights concerning alleged electoral roll irregularities.

They won the first three matches to seal the series before New Zealand bounced back with an 87-run victory in the fourth T20I.
